title.en: Add citations without saving the full text
title.zh: 仅添加引用，不保存全文

body.en: Adding a paper to a project now saves just its citation by default, so you can cite a paper without downloading its PDF and full text, and adding a batch of papers runs in parallel instead of one at a time.
body.zh: 向项目添加论文时，现在默认只保存其引用信息，无需下载 PDF 和全文即可引用；批量添加论文时会并行处理，而不再逐篇进行。

title.en: Keep LaTeX auxiliary files out of sight
title.zh: 隐藏 LaTeX 辅助文件

body.en: A new global setting keeps the .aux, .log and other files LaTeX writes in a hidden .research/build folder instead of next to your sources. Thanks to @dromeroc for the request (#890).
body.zh: 新的全局设置可以把 LaTeX 生成的 `.aux`、`.log` 等文件放进隐藏的 `.research/build` 文件夹，而不是放在源文件旁边。感谢 @dromeroc 提出这一需求（#890）。

body.en: A new layout preset puts the bibliography beside your document, and each layout remembers which document it had open.
body.zh: 新的布局预设会把参考文献放在文档旁边，并且每个布局都会记住它打开的文档。

fixes.en: Visual mode renders figures, tables and the title block, and shows what citations and references point to so you can jump there.
fixes.zh: 可视模式现在会渲染图表、表格和标题区块，并显示引用和交叉引用指向的位置，可直接跳转过去。

fixes.en: LaTeX formatting buttons toggle formatting off again instead of nesting another command.
fixes.zh: LaTeX 格式按钮再次点击时会取消格式，而不再嵌套一层命令。

fixes.en: You can delete a project's main .tex document.
fixes.zh: 现在可以删除项目的主 `.tex` 文档。

fixes.en: Linux: an open project no longer rescans itself three times a second, and shortcuts read Ctrl+Shift+J instead of ⌘⇧J.
fixes.zh: Linux：打开的项目不再每秒重复扫描三次，快捷键显示为 Ctrl+Shift+J 而不是 ⌘⇧J。
